description: This file defines the 'BlacklistUsername' ResultSet class in the Coocook schema, providing methods to add usernames to a blacklist and check if a username is okay, extending base ResultSet functionality with specific blacklist logic.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::ResultSet::BlacklistUsername
classes.description: A ResultSet class for managing blacklisted usernames within the Coocook schema, providing methods to add and validate usernames against a blacklist.

methods.name: add_username
methods.description: Adds a username to the blacklist with optional additional column data.

methods.name: is_username_ok
methods.description: Checks if a username is not blacklisted, utilizing the underlying '_is_value_ok' method.
